name: Polvo
label: Merge
lede: Two guitarists who met in a Spanish class at UNC, broke their strings on purpose, and made Chapel Hill's most tangled records, then spent thirty years telling people they were not a math rock band.

eras.title: A Spanish class at UNC
eras.text: Ash Bowie and Dave Brylawski met in a Spanish class at the University of North Carolina, bonding over SST records and Mitch Easter's Let's Active. With bassist Steve Popson and a jazz-minded drummer, Eddie Watkins, they gave themselves the Spanish word for dust.

q: was probably the most seasoned musician of all of us
years.h: Ash Bowie and Dave Brylawski start Polvo in Chapel Hill
years.p: UNC classmates Ash Bowie and Dave Brylawski form Polvo with drummer Eddie Watkins; bassist Steve Popson joins soon after.
years.xp: Popson called Watkins the most experienced player of the four, bringing jazz ideas and unusual drumming that set the band's template. At first they felt like outsiders in the Chapel Hill scene.

years.h: Polvo's first release: the Can I Ride double 7-inch
years.p: Kitchen Puff Records puts out Polvo's seven-song double 7-inch. Can I Ride and Vibracobra would be re-recorded for the first album.
years.xp: A version of Can I Ride turns up in Half-Cocked, the 1995 indie-rock road movie. The double single was later reissued as the Polvo EP.

eras.title: Slack strings on Merge
eras.text: Polvo signed to Merge Records, the label Mac McCaughan and Laura Ballance of Superchunk ran out of Chapel Hill. Bowie's guitars sounded like they were melting, and critics reached for Sonic Youth and Gentle Giant in the same review.

years.h: Cor-Crane Secret, cut in four days in Raleigh
years.p: Polvo record their first album at Jerry Kee's Duck Kee Studios in Raleigh from January 2 to 5, 1992, mostly live to tape. Merge releases Cor-Crane Secret that year.
years.xp: Ash Bowie's sound came partly from breaking strings and playing on anyway in odd, slack tunings, with a push from My Bloody Valentine's Isn't Anything. A Casio MT-65, the keyboard heard on the Ghostbusters theme, shows up on every Polvo record.

years.h: Today's Active Lifestyles and the Jehovah's Witnesses
years.p: Polvo's second album, produced by [[Bob Weston|7364260a-0a3e-4a6c-bcf8-b4e743c0b2c0]] in four December days, comes out on Merge. Its original cover art is pulled after a copyright dispute with the Jehovah's Witnesses.
years.xp:
Wikipedia says early pressings showed red tigers on a yellow background. When Merge reissued the record in 2020, the cover kept only the tigers, and the band maintained the original design came from public-domain sources.

The album leaned hard into the Middle Eastern modes that would define Polvo. Hot Press compared it to Sonic Youth with untuned guitars.

years.h: Celebrate the New Dark Age EP on Merge
years.p: A Polvo EP on Merge between the second album and the band's move to Touch and Go.

years.h: Ash Bowie moves to Boston to be with Helium's Mary Timony
years.p: Ash Bowie relocates to Boston to be with [[Mary Timony|d9c8dc3c-15b8-40d5-8153-ae9214aeef55]] of [[Helium|573510d6-bb5d-4d07-b0aa-ea6afe39e28d]], his girlfriend, and plays bass in her band, leaving Polvo split across two cities.

years.h: This Eclipse, Polvo's last release for Merge in the '90s
years.p: Polvo's EP This Eclipse closes their first run on Merge. The next records go to Chicago's Touch and Go.

eras.title: A double album, then everybody scatters
eras.text: Polvo moved to Touch and Go and went big with a double album. Then life pulled the band apart: the drummer had a family, one guitarist was in Boston, the other headed for New York and India.

years.h: Exploded Drawing, a Polvo double album on Touch and Go
years.p: Polvo's first record for Chicago's Touch and Go is their longest and most ambitious, sprawling across a double album with Indian and Middle Eastern drones.

years.h: Eddie Watkins leaves Polvo to raise a family
years.p: After three albums and several EPs, drummer Eddie Watkins quits Polvo. He had married and was the first in the band to have children.
With Brian Walsby on drums, Polvo regroup for Shapes on Touch and Go while Dave Brylawski is headed to graduate school in New York and trips to India.

years.h: Polvo's farewell: two nights at the Cat's Cradle
years.p: Polvo end a farewell US tour with a two-night stand at the Cat's Cradle, their hometown club, and split amicably.

eras.title: Libraness, Idyll Swords and a bar in Raleigh
eras.text: Nobody quit music. Bowie made records under a new name, Brylawski played Indonesian-inflected music, and Popson ran a club.

years.h: Ash Bowie's Libraness debut on Tiger Style
years.p: Ash Bowie releases Yesterday...and Tomorrow's Shells as Libraness on Tiger Style Records.

years.h: Dave Brylawski's Idyll Swords; Steve Popson runs Kings in Raleigh
years.p: Dave Brylawski plays in the Indonesian-influenced trio Idyll Swords, later joining Steve Popson in [[Black Taj|0e01b620-8cd8-4637-9480-1ebbae6a82ef]]. Popson owns Kings, a Raleigh music club.

eras.title: Called back by All Tomorrow's Parties
eras.text: A festival invitation got the three original songwriters back in a room after a decade. With a new drummer they rewrote the old songs instead of replaying them, then made two new records for Merge.

years.h: Polvo reunite for All Tomorrow's Parties and Primavera
years.p: Invited to play All Tomorrow's Parties and Barcelona's Primavera Sound, Polvo re-form with Brian Quast, formerly of [[The Cherry Valence|3298a4be-175c-43ac-b749-6107b0222112]], on drums.
years.xp: Rather than replay the '90s records note for note, the band reworked and rewrote older material for the reunion sets.

years.h: In Prism, Polvo's first album in 12 years
years.p: Back on Merge, Polvo release In Prism, their first studio album since Shapes in 1997.
Polvo's sixth album, Siberia, comes out on Merge with no press push behind it.

eras.title: Losing Eddie, finding the old records
eras.text: The original drummer died young. A few years later Merge reissued the first two albums, and the band admitted they liked them more than they'd remembered.

years.h: Eddie Watkins, Polvo's original drummer, dies at 47
years.p: Eddie Watkins dies on a Sunday evening in Durham, aged 47. No cause of death was made public.
years.xp: After Polvo he worked as a senior project manager at LexisNexis and played drums in Stranger in the Valley of the Kings.

years.h: Merge reissues Cor-Crane Secret and Today's Active Lifestyles
years.p: Merge reissues Polvo's first two albums. Ash Bowie says that after 20 years of not listening, he actually enjoyed them.
